diff_style.description: Control diff rendering style: 'auto' adapts to terminal width, 'stacked' always shows single column

server.description: Server configuration for merak serve and web commands

mdnsDomain.description: Custom domain name for mDNS service (default: merakcode.local)

cors.description: Additional domains to allow for CORS

urls.description: URLs to fetch skills from (e.g., https://example.com/.well-known/skills/)

autoupdate.description: Automatically update to the latest version. Set to true to auto-update, false to disable, or 'notify' to show update notifications

disabled_providers.description: Disable providers that are loaded automatically

enabled_providers.description: When set, ONLY these providers will be enabled. All other providers will be ignored

model.description: Model to use in the format of provider/model, eg anthropic/claude-2

small_model.description: Small model to use for tasks like title generation in the format of provider/model

default_agent.description: Default agent to use when none is specified. Must be a primary agent. Falls back to 'build' if not set or if the specified agent is invalid.

provider.description: Custom provider configurations and model overrides

disabled.description: Disable this variant for the model

setCacheKey.description: Enable promptCacheKey for this provider (default false)

promptCacheRetention.description: OpenAI prompt cache retention policy when promptCacheKey is enabled.

timeout.description: Timeout in milliseconds for requests to this provider. Default is 300000 (5 minutes). Set to false to disable timeout.

anyOf.description: Timeout in milliseconds for requests to this provider. Default is 300000 (5 minutes). Set to false to disable timeout.
Disable timeout for this provider entirely.

command.description: Command and arguments to run the MCP server

environment.description: Environment variables to set when running the MCP server

enabled.description: Enable or disable the MCP server on startup

timeout.description: Timeout in ms for MCP server requests. Defaults to 5000 (5 seconds) if not specified.

deferred.description: Set true to defer-load this server's tools via tool_search to reduce per-turn token cost. Defaults to false: tools stay registered eagerly.

url.description: URL of the remote MCP server

enabled.description: Enable or disable the MCP server on startup

headers.description: Headers to send with the request

oauth.description: Remote MCP OAuth. Set false to keep header auth only.

timeout.description: Timeout in ms for MCP server requests. Defaults to 5000 (5 seconds) if not specified.

deferred.description: Set true to defer-load this server's tools via tool_search to reduce per-turn token cost. Defaults to false: tools stay registered eagerly.

transport.description: Explicit transport protocol for the remote MCP server

instructions.description: Additional instruction files or patterns to include

user.description: Global user rules, always applied across all projects. Only read from global config; ignored in project config.

auto.description: Enable automatic compaction when context is full (default: true)

prune.description: Enable pruning of old tool outputs (default: true)

reserved.description: Token buffer for compaction. Leaves enough window to avoid overflow during compaction.

failureThreshold.description: After this many consecutive auto-compaction failures, trip the breaker and switch to aggressive prune + blocking limit (default 3)

blockingLimit.description: After the breaker trips, hard-stop and notify the user if the context still exceeds capacity (default true)

lossless.description: Lossless folding of tool output (default true). Strips ANSI color codes and folds adjacent repeated lines, repeated blocks and repeated path prefixes; every transform is round-trip checked and skipped if it cannot be restored exactly. No information is lost, and it runs before lossy compaction and truncation.

read_lifecycle.description: Read lifecycle management (default true). Projection layer: a Read is marked stale when the same file is edited afterwards, and superseded when it is read again with an overlapping range; either is replaced with a short notice. Storage is untouched and this is recomputed every turn. Reads within the last recent_turns turns are left alone to keep the cache.

stale.description: Handle Reads whose content is outdated (a quality issue, default true)

superseded.description: Handle redundant repeated Reads (saves space, default true)

recent_turns.description: Protection window: Reads within the last N user turns are not replaced, to keep the prompt cache stable (default 2)

input_budget.description: Tool input content truncation (on by default). Projection layer: content fields in write/edit/multi_edit/apply_patch inputs that exceed the dynamic budget are truncated (filePath/path are kept) and a marker says the file can be re-read with Read. Independent of output cleanup and its dynamic budget. Inputs within the last recent_turns turns are not truncated, to keep the cache.

enabled.description: Whether to truncate tool input content (default true). Set false to disable.

share.description: Dynamic budget share: budget = clamp(usable * share, min, max), default 0.1

min.description: Lower bound of the dynamic budget in tokens, default 4000

max.description: Upper bound of the dynamic budget in tokens, default 20000

max_chars_per_field.description: Maximum length of a single content field after truncation (characters), default 4000

auto_extract.description: Post-turn memory extraction policy. Default signals (extract only when needed). false disables it; true/signals extracts only on turns with memory signals; always extracts at the end of every root turn; unset means signals.

auto_recall.description: Whether to enable memory recall. Default false (off): past memories are not recalled into the context automatically. true: at the start of every user turn, relevant memories are recalled by keyword (optionally reranked by an LLM) and injected into the context.

model.description: Model for post-turn memory extraction. Defaults to small_model, then the turn model.

recall_rerank.description: Rerank strategy for memory recall (only applies when auto_recall=true). off disables it (keyword scoring only); auto reranks the top-N candidates with the small model when memory.model/small_model is configured, and falls back to keyword scoring when it is not configured or the call fails.

session_memory.description: Whether to enable SessionMemory (session notes). Default true (on). When on, a forked small model maintains per-session notes at token thresholds (10K to start, then every 5K) so context can be restored after compaction. Set false to turn it off completely.

session_memory_compact.description: Use the SessionMemory notes instead of an LLM summary during compaction (saves one LLM call). Default true (on). Only applies when session_memory is not disabled; falls back to the LLM summary automatically when the notes are empty or fail. Set false to always use the LLM summary.

extract_interval.description: Memory extraction throttle: extract once every N finished turns, default 1 (every turn). Larger values fork fewer child sessions and save cost.

auto_dream.description: Whether to enable AutoDream (memory consolidation). Default false (off). When on, a child session is forked periodically to review the memory directory and merge, deduplicate, refine and prune the index, consolidating fragmented memories into organized, non-redundant long-term memory. Only applies when auto_extract is on (no extraction means nothing to consolidate).

dream_min_hours.description: AutoDream time gate: minimum hours since the last consolidation, default 24. Consolidation runs only when dream_min_sessions is also met.

dream_min_sessions.description: AutoDream session gate: minimum number of new sessions since the last consolidation, default 5. Consolidation runs only when dream_min_hours is also met.

auto_activate.description: Auto-activate deferred tools on a strong match (default true). When a word in the user's request exactly matches an id segment or alias of a deferred tool, its full schema is injected in this turn, so the model does not need an extra tool_search round. Set false to go back to the old behavior where the model discovers tools on its own.

rerank.description: Small-model selection for deferred tool search (default off). off uses keyword scoring only; auto, when the candidate count reaches the threshold (mostly with many MCP servers) and small_model is configured, lets the small model pick and activate the tools that are actually needed. Falls back to keywords only when not configured, on timeout or on failure.

bash_output_compaction.description: Enable Bash output compaction, or configure thresholds for the compactor.

tool_result_delta.description: Collapse unchanged repeated glob/grep/ls results within a short session TTL.

primary_tools.description: Tools that should only be available to primary agents.

continue_loop_on_deny.description: Continue the agent loop when a tool call is denied

mcp_timeout.description: Timeout in milliseconds for model context protocol (MCP) requests

autoScroll.description: Auto-scroll the conversation to the bottom

retention_days.description: Delete sessions inactive for more than N days; by default no history is deleted

sandbox.description: Sandbox for the commands the agent runs.

mode.description: preferred (default): use the sandbox when it is ready; until then commands that change things ask first, even in auto mode. required: refuse to run commands while the sandbox is not ready. off: never use the sandbox.

deny.description: Extra folders commands cannot read, besides ~/.ssh, ~/.aws and the other credential folders. ~/ means your home folder.

allow.description: Extra folders commands can always write, besides the workspace, the temp folder and package caches.

allowLocalPorts.description: Linux only: local ports commands may connect to directly, for example a database at 127.0.0.1:5432.

redactSecrets.description: Hide API keys, tokens and passwords in command output before the model sees it. Defaults to true.

variant.description: Default model variant for this agent (applies only when using the agent's configured model).

description.description: Description of when to use the agent

hidden.description: Hide this subagent from the @ autocomplete menu (default: false, only applies to mode: subagent)

color.description: Hex color code (e.g., #FF5733) or theme color (e.g., primary)

steps.description: Maximum number of agentic iterations before forcing text-only response

disableTools.description: Tool ids to remove from this agent's available-tools pool (e.g. pdf_parse, workflow_run) — reduces per-turn tool-schema token cost for tools this agent will never use. Only ever narrows the existing pool; unknown ids are ignored.

deferTools.description: Tool ids to defer-load: kept out of the tools array (only a one-line summary in the tool_search description) until the model activates one via tool_search, after which it is available with full parameters on the next turn. Defaults to [pdf_parse, excel_parse, excel_write, workflow_run]. Pass an empty array to disable deferral entirely (load all tools eagerly). Only applies to tools still in the pool (respecting disableTools).

protected_write.description: Write .git and dotfiles inside the workspace

bash_delete.description: Run commands that delete files (rm, git clean, ...)

bash_risky.description: Run risky commands (sudo, git push, npm publish, ...)

bash_forbidden.description: Run commands that wipe the system or home folder, format disks or write raw disks (denied unless allowed here)

bash_unsandboxed.description: Run a command that may change things while the sandbox is not ready

sandbox.description: Run a command with extra sandbox permissions
